channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Mano Ferreira: Especialistas consideram abrupta transição do Bolsa Família
item.description: Experts cited by Mano Ferreira view the Bolsa Família transition as abrupt, whether under the current one-year model or the two-year proposal from Flávio Bolsonaro's team (PL). The rule provides for an immediate cutoff of benefits without a gradual phase, according to analysis on Pulso Político at Canal UOL.

item.title: Janones é recebido por apoiadores ao ter alta hospitalar e compara Lula a Messi
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) was received by supporters after being discharged from the Vila Nova Star Hospital in São Paulo, where he was admitted for cardiac arrhythmia. During the event, he compared President Lula to football player Lionel Messi, sparking political reactions.

item.title: Nikolas Ferreira publica relatos de nordestinos sobre pobreza e falta de oportunidades
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) released a video featuring testimonies from Northeast residents about poverty, lack of access to medications and water, and limited job opportunities. The content criticizes the federal government of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and highlights youth migration from the region in search of employment. The publication aims to raise public awareness about regional inequalities in Brazil.

item.title: Prefeitura de SP confirma vazamento de dados de 58.000 câmeras
item.description: The São Paulo City Hall confirmed a data leak from the Smart Sampa surveillance system, which monitors over 58,000 cameras, but denied platform security failures. The incident, attributed to an employee under investigation, exposed sensitive data for 11 months. Mayor Ricardo Nunes defended the system as secure, while the report revealed access to images from schools and hospitals.

item.title: Vídeo: TSE pede que eleitor confira endereço de sua seção eleitoral
item.description: The Brazilian Electoral Court (TSE) reports that 554 polling stations changed locations between the first and second rounds, mostly due to weather-related damages. Voters can check their updated voting location through the TSE website or the e-Título app.

item.title: Lula lidera engajamento nas redes em todo o 2º turno, com 200 milhões de interações
item.description: Lula led social media engagement during the 2026 election runoff, reaching 200 million interactions—three times more than Flávio Bolsonaro (54 million). The analysis by Projeto Brief shows a reversal from the first round, where Flávio dominated most metrics.

item.title: TV CELULAR | O BRASIL VAI VENCER 19/10/2026
item.description: Political promotional video supporting Brazil, released in the context of the 2026 elections. Contains digital campaign elements but does not directly mention specific candidates.

item.title: Por agenda, Lula prevê ato do transporte gratuito para quinta
item.description: President Lula postponed the Planalto Palace event to Thursday (22) to submit a PEC establishing free public transport on weekends to the National Congress. The initiative is part of measures announced by his government and campaign during the final stretch of the election race.

item.title: Flávio à frente de Lula, pressão do TSE sobre a Meta e debates: as últimas notícias da eleição ao vivo
item.description: Young voters express their preferences and concerns for the 2026 elections, highlighting the influence of social media and the difficulty in distinguishing truth from misinformation. The content reflects movement in the race, mentioning figures like Flávio and Lula, and calls for TSE pressure regarding Meta.

item.title: Meta diz ao TSE que adotou revisão humana em bloqueios a perfis de campanha
item.description: Meta reported to the TSE that it has adopted human review for blocking campaign ads on its platforms. The measure responds to a requirement from the Brazilian electoral court, which has been pressing the company to enhance transparency and oversight of political content. Meta did not disclose details about the number of profiles affected or the impact of the new policy.

item.title: TSE determina que Nikolas Ferreira e Pablo Marçal não publiquem conteúdos já vetados
item.description: The TSE prohibited Nikolas Ferreira and Pablo Marçal from publishing previously censored content on social media, reinforcing digital control over the electorate. The decision aims to ensure compliance with electoral regulations and prevent misinformation on social platforms.

item.title: Novo pede cassação de Lula após pacotão eleitoreiro do PT
item.description: The Novo party filed an Electoral Judicial Investigation Action (AIJE) requesting the annulment of Lula and Alckmin's ticket over alleged irregularities in economic benefit measures. The action seeks an eight-year ban from running for office for both. The case will be analyzed by the TSE.

item.title: Real Time Big Data: maioria aprova promessas de Lula e Flávio que aumentam gastos públicos
item.description: Most voters support public spending promises from Lula and Flávio, including expanded Farmácia Popular with exams (74%) and five new federal prisons (82%). Infrastructure and security proposals also gain broad backing, even among opponents' supporters. The poll does not provide cost or funding details.

item.title: Janones avisa no Exército do Lula que terá alta nesta 3ª feira
item.description: Federal congressman André Janones (Rede-MG) announced via the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula' that he will be discharged from Vila Nova Star Hospital at 1:13 PM, symbolically referencing the PT's number. Hospitalized in the ICU for cardiac arrhythmia after the presidential debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, he reported being clinically stable and plans to hold a live broadcast with supporters on upcoming campaign steps.

item.title: Promessa de Flávio aumenta prazo de proteção a beneficiários do Bolsa Família de 18 meses para dois anos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposed extending from 18 to 24 months the Bolsa Família Beneficiary Continuity Benefit protection period, allowing families who obtain formal employment or start their own business to maintain half of the assistance for a longer time. The measure aims to provide financial security during the economic transition and provides for automatic return to the program if the new income is not consolidated. The proposal was presented by Daniella Marques, coordinator of the economic area of the campaign.

item.title: A pergunta incômoda que a guerra de Trump impõe a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Trump's war in the Middle East has raised oil prices, affecting Brazil both as an exporter and consumer. Both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will face the need to maintain or revise fuel subsidies, but Flávio offers no clear proposals to address the international inflationary impact.

item.title: Governo Lula projeta falta de recursos a partir de 2028
item.description: The Lula administration (PT) warns of a fiscal crisis starting in 2028, after mobilizing 300 billion reais in 2026 for social benefits, and proposes a gradual fiscal adjustment to Congress to prevent cuts to public policies.

item.title: Após supostas regalias, Milton Leite é transferido de cadeia na Grande SP
item.description: Former councilman Milton Leite (União) was transferred from Mogi das Cruzes Prison amid allegations of prison privileges. He is detained on suspicion of involvement in a PCC scheme with bus companies. The 'Custody (Un)Feal' operation led to arrests, search warrants, and the seizure of R$155,000.

item.title: Vicentinho tem 52% contra 48% de Dorinha no 2º turno no TO
item.description: A Real Time Big Data survey released on October 20, 2026 shows federal deputy Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) leading with 52% of valid voting intentions against Senator Professor Dorinha (União Brasil) at 48% in the Tocantins gubernatorial runoff. The poll surveyed 1,600 voters from October 15-19, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Willer Tomaz apostou R$ 4,8 milhões em bet acusada de lavar dinheiro do PCC
item.description: Lawyer Willer Tomaz, linked to former senator Flávio Bolsonaro, wagered R$4.8 million at Bet7K, accused of money laundering for the PCC. The Federal Police's 'Narco Bet' operation in November 2025 investigates alleged money laundering through online games and cryptocurrency transfers. Tomaz is also under investigation for R$1.4 billion in transactions at Blaze betting house, claiming gambling addiction to recover funds.

item.title: PM promete investigar policias que liberaram bolsonarista que socou mulher
item.description: The São Paulo Military Police opened a preliminary investigation into officers who released a man who assaulted a woman at the Butantã Metro station. The attacker, identified as Diogo Freire through a viral video, had participated in a pro-Flávio Bolsonaro rally and previously faced a court order for threats.

item.title: Quem não votou no 1º turno pode votar no 2º? Tire essa e outras dúvidas
item.description: The second round of the 2026 elections takes place this Sunday (25), deciding the next president between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Voters in five states and the Federal District also elect governors. Voting runs from 8am to 5pm (Brasília time).

item.title: Especialistas apontam lições da esquerda de outros Países que Lula deixou de aproveitar no Brasil
item.description: Experts note that Lula missed opportunities to adopt successful left-wing strategies from abroad, such as Claudia Sheinbaum's public security track record in Mexico. Although he adjusted his campaign after a significant vote gap in the first round, institutional constraints limit his ability to replicate external approaches.

item.title: Split payment vira disputa eleitoral; mas como de fato o mecanismo vai funcionar?
item.description: The split payment, an automatic tax collection mechanism planned in the tax reform, has become an electoral dispute topic for 2026. Flávio Bolsonaro's economic team proposes abolishing it, citing negative impacts on business cash flow, while the Lula administration argues its removal would raise the general IBS rate. The mechanism, still under development, does not affect MEIs and Simple National companies, with tests scheduled for 2027.

item.title: Novo pede cassação da chapa de Lula por medidas em ano eleitoral
item.description: The Novo party requested the annulment of Lula and Alckmin's ticket for allegedly using economic measures during the electoral year. The lawsuit identifies 35 measures implemented in 2026, including a raise in Bolsa Família and fuel subsidies.

item.title: Meta responde ao TSE e diz que está tratando candidaturas de forma igual
item.description: Meta responded to the TSE stating that it treats the candidacies of Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula equally and without discrimination, submitting documents proving compliance with court orders. The company highlighted the implementation of a whitelist for political ads and the deactivation of two suspicious profiles, reinforcing the equality mechanism required by Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze. The submission follows pressure from Lula's coalition, which accuses the platform of limiting post reach and favoring the opponent.

item.title: Meta diz que campanhas de Lula e Flávio são tratadas “de forma igual”
item.description: Meta submitted a report to the TSE confirming equal treatment of Lula and Flávio campaigns without discrimination, following Minister Bellizze's decision on content distribution equity across the company's platforms.

item.title: Campanha de Lula escala Alckmin para rebater Flávio sobre ‘tesouraço’ de R$ 200 bilhões e compara medida com governo Milei
item.description: Lula's campaign uses Alckmin to criticize Flávio Bolsonaro's proposed R$200 billion budget cut, comparing it to Argentina's fiscal adjustment policies under Milei. Alckmin questions the feasibility of the measure without details on cuts and warns about impacts on social benefits.

item.title: Meta diz ao TSE que deu tratamento igual às campanhas de Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula
item.description: Meta told the TSE it treated the campaigns of Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula equally, without favoring either. Responding to a lawsuit filed by the PT, the company outlined corrective measures taken after court orders, emphasizing that content is handled impartially and official profiles are not prioritized by the algorithm.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta terça-feira (20)
item.description: On Tuesday (20), the runoff presidential candidates have distinct schedules. Lula (PT) attends an event in São Luís (MA) and a walk in Juazeiro (BA) and Petrolina (PE). Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has a restricted schedule, recording campaign programs in São Paulo and Goiânia.

item.title: Ex-vereador de Queimados morre baleado durante abordagem da PM no Rio
item.description: Former councilman Jefferson Dias da Silva was shot dead by military police during a traffic stop on Avenida Brasil in Rio de Janeiro. The incident occurred after the driver allegedly failed to comply with an order to stop. The DHC is investigating the case.

item.title: A burocracia na Ancine
item.description: Film producers who won the EBC 'Seleção TV Brasil' tender face uncertainty over potential project cancellations if Lula loses on Sunday. The report highlights bureaucratic concerns at Ancine and risks to the Brazilian audiovisual sector.

item.title: Crusoé: 85% são contra presidente indicar ministros ao STF, indica Realtime
item.description: A survey by Realtime Big Data shows that 85% of Brazilians support removing the president's prerogative to appoint STF ministers. Only 7% oppose this change. The survey was released following the first electoral round and considering the court's renewal in the coming years.

item.title: Quem são os deputados federais eleitos em 2026?
item.description: Brazilian voters elected 513 federal deputies in the first round on October 4, 2026, distributing seats among parties and fusions via proportional representation. Mandates last four years, with inauguration scheduled for February 1, 2027. Below is the list of elected deputies by state.

item.title: Quem ganhou as eleições de 2026 para senador?
item.description: The 2026 elections elected 54 senators to eight-year terms, renewing two-thirds of the 81 seats in the Federal Senate. The two most-voted candidates in each state were elected, with representatives from parties such as PL, PT, MDB, and PSD winning seats nationwide.

item.title: Meta diz ao TSE que tomou medidas para candidaturas serem tratadas de forma igual
item.description: Meta responded to the TSE stating it has taken measures to ensure equal treatment of candidates in the second round of elections, claiming compliance with court orders without negligence. The company submitted a document with a technical statement attesting to equal treatment of political content and election ad placement, following a decision by Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze. The campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro had previously alleged damages to content distribution on Meta's platforms.

item.title: Após desvantagem no primeiro turno, Lula diminui falas sobre bets e evita falar de futebol
item.description: After Flávio Bolsonaro's lead in the first round, Lula's campaign reduced references to bets in speeches and avoids discussing football impacts. The strategy aims to refocus on core campaign issues.

item.title: Analistas esperam BNDES mais enxuto em eventual governo Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Analysts expect a more restrained BNDES role in economic financing if Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) takes office in 2026. The outlook points to a conservative approach compared to previous administrations.

item.title: "Lula está cagando para Amazônia”, diz Flávio ao ser cobrado sobre fumaça
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Lula for not fighting Amazon fires and claimed he would address the issue if elected. In Manaus, he was pressed about the smoke covering the city and promised action against wildfires.

item.title: O controle e o rastreamento de armas e munições - O Assunto #1828
item.description: In episode #1828 of the podcast O Assunto, Roberto Uchôa discusses the need to modernize the State to combat crime, emphasizing the importance of controlling and tracking firearms and ammunition. The debate covers data on violence in Brazil, including the use of firearms in 70% of homicides and joint police actions supported by technologies such as the DNA Database.

item.title: Depois da emoção da campanha, uma grande tarefa nos espera
item.description: The article highlights the final stretch of the 2026 Brazilian election, emphasizing the tension and stakes of the runoff. With a reflective tone, it points to the challenges the winner will face upon taking office, especially in areas like the economy, security, and structural reforms. Available exclusively to subscribers, the analysis offers an in-depth look at the key issues shaping the vote.

item.title: Eleições 2026: acompanhe a apuração em todo o Brasil
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections feature real-time vote counting coverage by g1, including results for the presidency and runoff elections in five states and the Federal District. Data is provided by the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) and updated live with interactive maps, charts, and detailed regional analysis.

item.title: Bolsa Família: veja o novo calendário após governo antecipar pagamentos antes do 2º turno das eleições
item.description: The federal government advanced Bolsa Família payments to before the second round of elections, benefiting all recipients with adjusted amounts before October 25. The payment schedule was condensed into three days, with a 15% increase in the minimum family benefit from R$600 to R$691. The measure aims to mitigate the effects of the super El Niño on vulnerable families.

item.title: Raio-X do Fla: números de Jardim são melhores que o de Filipe Luís no comando do rubro-negro em torneio nacional; veja comparativo
item.description: Leonardo Jardim outperformed Filipe Luís in points accumulated over the first 28 Brazilian Championship games for Flamingo, but showed a weaker defense. The Portuguese coach reached 63 points against 61 from his predecessor, scoring one more goal but conceding six more, leading to a less favorable goal difference (+36 vs +41).

item.title: Ato anti-Lula no campus da UFRN termina em pancadaria e briga generalizada
item.description: An anti-Lula rally at UFRN ended in clashes and fighting between right-wing groups and students, leaving injuries and property damage. The event, organized by conservative movements and supported by PL political figures, triggered academic disruption and class cancellations. The incident reflects the polarization surrounding education and security issues on campus.

item.title: Com Nikolas e Pavanato, Flávio reúne multidão em Manaus
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) held a campaign rally called 'Bloquinho do 22' in Manaus, accompanied by federal deputies Nikolas Ferreira and Lucas Pavanato, the two most voted candidates for the Chamber in 2026. The event gathered supporters in western Manaus with displays of support for the presidential race and the state government of Amazonas.

item.title: Lula diz que foi convencido a mudar opinião sobre maioridade penal
item.description: President Lula stated he was convinced to support lowering the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16 for heinous crimes, proposing a Senate amendment. He advocates strict punishment for 16-year-olds committing serious crimes, likening it to voting rights. Lula also defended temporary prison leaves ('saidinhas') as part of social rehabilitation, rejecting criticism over rare recidivism cases.

item.title: Campanha de Lula recorre ao TSE para acusar Meta de descumprir ordem judicial e prejudicar PT
item.description: Lula's campaign accuses Meta of failing to comply with a TSE order and favoring Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, filing a new motion with the court. The PT alleges the platform's AI generates content referencing candidate number 22 without direct mention. European and OAS observers participated in discussions regarding the allegations.

item.title: Incrédula com força de Flávio, eleitora de Lula diz que democracia está em jogo
item.description: A Lula voter in upscale Fortaleza neighborhoods says democracy is at stake, expressing support for the candidacy with strength akin to Flávio's. The text highlights the contrast between local life and the voter's political stance.

item.title: Inquérito sobre suspeita de lavagem de Flávio Bolsonaro também investiga Cláudio Castro e Ramagem
item.description: The Federal Police investigation into suspected money laundering involving Flávio Bolsonaro also investigates Cláudio Castro and Alexandre Ramagem. The probe examines potential misconduct by the three PL politicians.
